title: [Crystalline Depths, Terrace]
description: A dark, hollow molt lies in ragged pieces across the surface of the terrace, its chitinous surface dully reflecting the light of the crystals illuminating the cavern.  Several voracious larvae feast on the husk, trailing gooey mucus over its surfaces.  More pieces litter the rocky ground below the plaza, swarming with worm-like claimants driven by the mindless hunger of infancy.
